title: Well that wasn't fun
content: Last night I dreamt that I killed someone in the mall parking garage. Then I went back into the mall and tried to hide evidence. It seemed to be Christmas and there were tons of shoppers. I'm not sure who the man was, or why I did it, but I felt both guilt and fear of being caught. I wondered into some Chinese food food court place and I remember there was an old man serving food and it was smokey and there were a lot of red neon lights. I sat there for a long time wondering what to do. I felt like if I left the mall I'd be caught. It was like the mall became my prison. I'm sure there is some psychological meaning, but yeah mall world got scary for me last night. Also, disclaimer, I'm not a murderer. Lol.
